firstPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production transparent PNG animation atlas for an anthropomorphic female rabbit police officer desktop pet, inspired by Judy Hopps from Zootopia.
Character: charming, brave, energetic young-adult rabbit policewoman, upright bipedal anthropomorphic anatomy, long tall rabbit ears with pink inner ears, soft cool gray fur, pale muzzle and belly, small pink triangular rabbit nose, expressive violet eyes, rounded fluffy rabbit tail. Confident approachable smile. Compact cute proportions with a slightly large head, slender athletic body, NOT a human in costume. Polished cinematic 3D animated feature look, fine soft fur, clean materials, warm studio lighting. Blue police shirt under fitted navy protective vest, navy trousers, dark blue boots, utility belt, small metallic police shield badge on chest, small radio clipped to belt. No glasses, goggles, hat or engineer overalls. No gun. No text, lettering, city logos or watermark.
Consistent same individual, uniform, face, eye color, ear length, body proportions, lighting and camera across every cell.
Technical layout: ONE transparent PNG, desired 1024x2304, strict invisible uniform FOUR columns by NINE rows, exactly 36 full-body poses. Each 256x256 cell contains ONE rabbit. No borders, no grid lines, no captions, no background, no floor, no cast shadow. Genuine alpha. Full character including tips of both very long ears, boots, fluffy tail and props completely inside each cell, at least 22px clear padding on ALL four sides. Total height including ears around 195px. Keep coherent scale; preserve generous blank gutters between all rows and columns. Nothing clips, touches image edges or overlaps adjacent cells. Clean transparent edges with no colored halos.
Each row is a four-frame sequential action, left to right. Nine rows from top to bottom:
1 IDLE: front view standing alert, hands naturally by sides, gentle breathing; eyes open / half blink / closed blink / open. Ears mostly upright, slight ear sway.
2 PATROL RIGHT: side profile facing right, four distinct bipedal walking phases with alternating foot contact and arm swing. Full long ears within each cell.
3 PATROL LEFT: same four walking phases facing left.
4 GREETING: front view, raises right paw / friendly small wave outward / wave inward / lowers paw. Cheerful welcoming police officer.
5 HAPPY HOP: front view, crouch with knees bent / takes off with both feet lifting / airborne cheerful small hop / soft landing. Ear tips never leave the cell, no scale changes.
6 DISAPPOINTED: front view, ears gently droop / gaze lowers / small sigh / raises eyes with renewed determination. Not crying.
7 STANDBY: front view, listens attentively / ears tilt left / ears tilt right / returns to center, one paw resting near belt, calm alert expression.
8 RADIO: front three-quarter view holding one small dark police walkie-talkie near mouth: raises radio / speaks into it / pauses to listen / speaks again. Same radio and natural paw grip throughout all four frames. No floating symbols.
9 NOTES: front three-quarter view holding a small navy pocket notebook and a tiny pencil: reads / writes a short note / thoughtfully looks up / reads again. Notebook and pencil remain in paws in every frame. No legible writing.
The result must be the usable sprite sheet itself, not a mockup. Emphasize Judy Hopps-like rabbit police character appeal, long expressive ears, blue uniform and optimistic determined personality.
